dedupe_keys.name: republic of the congo health statistical yearbook annuaire statistique sanitaire health facilities staff equipment water electricity and waste management by department

description: The health statistical yearbook of the Republic of the Congo is the ministry of health's main compilation of data on its health facilities and services. The latest official edition, covering 2021 to 2023, runs to 250 pages and breaks figures down by department and health district. Beyond disease surveillance and target populations, it counts public, para-public and private health structures and the services they offer; staff by status and profession; laboratory, emergency and radiology equipment in district hospitals; vehicles and boats; communication means; how facilities manage and dispose of biomedical waste; access of health districts to water and electricity; and the budgets and own revenues of hospitals and health centres. Earlier editions for 2013, 2014, 2017-2018 and 2019-2020 are also listed. All are free to download as PDFs from the ministry website. Caveats: the tables are inside PDFs, editions are irregular, no licence is stated, and the figures depend on facility reporting completeness. Coverage is national. Simulation uses: mapping health facility dependence on water and power supply and on transport, and sizing health system capacity by department for resilience studies. Related records: Healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) gives open facility points that can be joined to these department totals.
